changeSet.author: vibe1
changeSet.comment: Schema for spring-modulith-starter-jpa's durable event publication registry (used by @ApplicationModuleListener, e.g. the calendar-sync listener). Hibernate only validates this JPA-mapped entity against the schema, it never creates it -- the exact column definitions below were captured verbatim from Hibernate's own schema-generation-to-script output against these dependency versions, not hand-guessed, since column lengths/types are version-sensitive.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE event_publication ( id UUID NOT NULL, listener_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, event_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, serialized_event VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, publication_date DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, completion_date DATETIME(6), status ENUM('COMPLETED','FAILED','PROCESSING','PUBLISHED','RESUBMITTED'), completion_attempts INT NOT NULL, last_resubmission_date DATETIME(6), PRIMARY KEY (id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB
